notes.title: 🧹 Bugfix Update - v1.1.2
notes.content:
Hello magical beings,

👾 Bugfixes
[list]
[*][b]Fixed progression issues in Challenge Mode:[/b]
Completing the fourth store in Challenge Mode now correctly unlocks the corresponding achievement. The game no longer shows the “You’ve unlocked Challenge Mode!” message erroneously.

[*][b]Resolved high score tracking errors:[/b]
The game now correctly registers and saves high scores when finishing a store, both in Casual and Challenge modes.

[*][b]Save system improvements:[/b]
Addressed a conflict where saves from Challenge Mode and Casual Mode could interfere with each other. Progress in each mode is now stored independently.

[*][b]Fixed broken modal in Challenge Mode:[/b]
The “Continue or Restart” modal now properly displays the translated text. There are no longer raw keys like challengeStore.continueOrRestart!

[*][b]ESC key no longer forces unwanted restarts:[/b]
Pressing ESC in the “Continue or Restart” modal now closes the window instead of deleting your progress. Your runs are safe! 💾
[/list]
⸻

We’re continuing to polish the game and address your reports, so keep sharing your magical findings with us!

With gratitude,
– Creative Hand Team 🪄

notes.title: Casual Mode Update - v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello magical beings, We are releasing the new version of Tiny Witch with great appreciation and pride. 

Thank you to everyone who has waited.

👑 Major Feature
[list]
[*] Casual Mode: A brand-new mode for players seeking a more relaxing and fun experience.
[/list]

⚒️ Improvements
[list]
[*] The tutorial has been updated with new images and clearer explanations about decorations, the Casual Mode, and other features.
[*] The "Restart Level" option was renamed to "Restart Day" for better clarity.
[*] Game commands now respond more smoothly, making gameplay feel more fluid.
[*] Texts across the game were adjusted to enhance localization, and the following languages were added:
[list]
 [*] Simplified Chinese (SCH)
 [*] Russian
 [*] Spanish (EU)
 [*] German
 [*] Japanese
 [*] French
 [*] Polish
 [*] Turkish
[/list]
[*] Interface improvements:
[list]
 [*] Tutorial messages and GIFs have been refined for easier understanding.
 [*] Text alignment and spacing issues across various screens (e.g., shop, recipe book, world map) have been fixed.
 [*] Menus such as "Attention" and "Resource Shortage" have been centralized for better readability.
 [*] Visual elements like titles and icons have been polished to ensure a cleaner experience.
 [*] Fonts were adjusted to better support Japanese and Chinese text, avoiding clipping or overlapping issues.
[/list]
[*] Decorations now affect the entire shop instead of just adjacent customers.
[*] A new visual feedback system shows buffs and debuffs on the little witch, including how long they last.
[*] Critters: New small creatures have been added to liven up the phases.
[*] Added a direction indicator to show which way the little witch is facing, improving navigation and gameplay clarity.
[/list]

👾 Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound of drips from leaks would persist indefinitely.
[*] Resolved a crash occurring during the night session of the shop.
[*] You can now restart any challenge shop and return to Day 01, even if not all days have been completed.
[*] Fixed a problem that caused the game to close when accessing credits in certain languages.
[*] Resolved an issue where the catalyst would disappear from the cauldron when exiting to the main menu without refunding the gold. The cauldron's state is now saved and restored properly.
[*] Other minor bugs were fixed to enhance overall stability and gameplay.
[/list]

Best Regards,
Creative Hand team

notes.title: 🥳 Happy New Year and News! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is Ramon, and I would like to wish you all a happy new year and share some news with you.

Firstly, I want to assure you that Tiny Witch has not been abandoned. We are currently working on free updates for this year and adding new features to the game. We have been away for a while due to some mental health issues, but we are now fully recovered and back to work.

Now for some of the news we're working on.

[list]
[*] We're working on a more casual way of playing without the stress of having to rush to deliver orders to customers. And we're also going to allow you to have more than one save so you can play in both modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277622/9080375c323cec9cacf7009c1cfc1ea61c36b2a9.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] Another thing we've been working on is improving the feedback when the little witch has a buff or debuff effect and the screen will show how much time she has left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277622/dc363b44c7185dfe1b3a7152d06c697b3c8a42eb.png[/img]

An example of all that we will have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277622/6def30223add36ab8a84ae047b78aa6b45ba334b.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] Another point we've been working on is bringing more decorations to the store that can make your gameplay different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277622/381a6ab0a6f9d08820e39a90422d5bdba91e42f9.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] And we'll also be working on bringing new languages to the game.

[hr][/hr]

[/list]
Let us know in the comments what new features you liked the most and what you'd like to see from Tiny Witch this year.


If you'd like to keep up with more of our work, here is our newsletter.
https://newsletter.creativehand.com.br/


Best regards,
Ramon Barbosa

notes.title: Tiny Witch is part of the 2023 Game Devs of Color Expo Steam sale!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s Suellen from Creative Hand! I wanted to let you know that today is the first day of the [b]Game Devs of Color Expo Steam[/b] sale! :) 

If you’re considering getting it, allow me to sell you on it! It’s a ✨ magical management simulator ✨ where you play as Sophie, a cute witch who must race to serve minions to her clientele. Race against the clock (and patrons’ simmering tempers) to create concoctions that will delight your customers and give you the reputation of the best witchy shop owner in the land! We went for a game with a cute and soft aesthetic but with a good degree of challenge – running a business isn’t easy, after all. 😉

If you’d like to play a game described as [url=https://vulgarknight.com/tiny-witch-review-pc/]“an itsy, bitsy, teeny game that you can’t help but fall in love with it from the get-go”[/url] and [url=https://ladiesgamers.com/tiny-witch-review/]“beautiful, adorable, wholesome, and so much fun”[/url], then look no further and get Tiny Witch today!

We hope you enjoy the Game Devs of Color Expo and that you take care. See you next time. 🔮

notes.title: Tiny Witch is part of the 2023 Latinx Games Festival!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s Suellen from Creative Hand, and I wanted to let you know that Tiny Witch is participating in the [b]5th annual Latinx Games Festival[/b]! It is the definitive video game industry event for Latinx game development, as it covers a wide range of topics that are important to Latinx game development through its many panels and makes sure to celebrate Latinx game developers. It means a lot to us as a team full of Brazilian developers, so we’re very excited to be participating! :) 

The event will be highlighting games from Latinx developers online from today, September 15, to September 24. If you’d like to attend in person at The Columbia Memorial Space Center on September 23, you can get tickets [url=https://t.co/w6vaT1wtHp]here[/url]. If you’d like to watch the streamable parts of the festival, you can watch it [url=https://www.twitch.tv/latinxgamesfestival]here[/url]. 

If this is your first time visiting the Tiny Witch page after seeing us in the festival: hello and thank you for taking the time to check out our cozy game! We’d be delighted to have you in our community of players. If you were already a fan of Tiny Witch, then thank you for sticking with us and supporting the game as it appears in different future events!

We’re excited to showcase Tiny Witch to the world even more from here on out, so keep an eye on our game’s future appearances – one is just around the corner!

notes.title: Tiny Witch is now available!
notes.content:
I’m Ramon from Creative Hand, and the day is finally here! Tiny Witch has launched [b]TODAY[/b]! 

Thank you so much for following our development and being excited for our game. We hope you enjoy what we’ve created for you. Most of the time, the team has been my wife and me, and we’ve worked hard to develop both the game and our company. For this project, we got the help of freelancers who live all across Brazil. Each one came to the project with dreams they wanted to fulfill and that they could accomplish by participating in Tiny Witch’s development. We are so grateful for their help. 

There was no easy part to developing Tiny Witch – each part was a different challenge, as it followed a different development proposal from our 2 other games. We’re proud of the obstacles we overcame to make it. 

We’re especially proud of creating Sophie, the tiny witch you play as. She goes beyond being a cute character, as she is strong and adventurous enough to go in search of her own dreams and deal with the variables that arise. Fun fact: She was inspired by my wife, Suellen, whom you have heard from in our posts here. 🙂

We hope you enjoy this frenetic and fun adventure that captures a bit of the feeling of creating your own business. It’s chaotic but it makes you grow and is always worth it. 

Tiny Witch’s playtime is approximately four to five hours. If you like it, please feel free to leave a review – it helps small developers like us so much! 

Take care and see you next time!

notes.title: Tiny Witch is launching on September 1st!!!
notes.content:
🔮 Greetings, you magical beings! 🔮

I’m Suellen from Creative Hand, and I’m so delighted to bring you some exciting news: [b]Tiny Witch is coming out on September 1st![/b]

It’s been a while since we updated you on its progress, and that’s because we were working hard to finish the game for all of you. The end is in sight, and we couldn’t wait to share the news with you, so here we are! 

Tiny Witch’s playtime will be approximately four to five hours – it’s an experience that won’t take up your entire day, but that we hope will offer you a lot of fun and joy in a cute, wholesome package. :) 

We’re big fans of management games and as a company, we’re choosing to make cute, colorful, and wholesome games. Even though our game is relatively small, we think it has a lot of heart. Everyone who has developed Tiny Witch lives across different regions in Brazil, so we’ve developed this game over the course of many calls and coordinations. Most of the time, we are only a team of 2 – my husband and I – but we’ve gotten so much help from our incredible freelancers. Each one of them has worked on fulfilling a dream through Tiny Witch, so we hope you enjoy their hard work and enjoy our game!

To make sure you know the latest, be sure to follow our updates on here and sign up for our shiny new [url=https://newsletter.creativehand.com.br/]newsletter[/url]. See you on launch day!

notes.title: A new trailer for Tiny Witch this way comes!
notes.content:
🔮 Greetings, you magical beings! 🔮

I’m Ramon from Creative Hand, and I’m delighted to show you the new trailer for our upcoming magical management sim, Tiny Witch! 

Since you last heard of us, we’ve been working hard on making Tiny Witch the best witchy shop simulator it can be. We’ve not only been improving upon what you know of the game, but also we have been creating new features that we’re really excited to share with you in due time. :)

Tiny Witch is currently being made by a small but mighty team of 4, so we’ve wanted to take our time getting things right as we gear up for release. That release might be sooner than you think, so keep your eyes peeled for more from us in the coming weeks. To make sure you know the latest, be sure to follow our updates on here and sign up for our shiny new [url=https://newsletter.creativehand.com.br]Newsletter[/url].

We hope you enjoyed this new footage – get ready for some joyful and whimsical times ahead! :) Thanks so much for your support and anticipation for our game. We’ll have more to reveal very soon. 

[previewyoutube=ZfY7st-PXl8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Taking a moment to highlight a big inspiration for Tiny Witch
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40614223/0cc7674977d2247acfffc87976438d2d333a2a3e.png[/img]

Hello guys,

I am Ramon, the developer of Tiny Witch, and I bring news for you.
Firstly, thank you very much to all of you who have played, left your ideas, and reported any bugs you found. ❤️ We have seen your feedback and gameplay videos, and we are updating Tiny Witch based on them.

I wanted to take today to highlight one of my biggest inspirations for Tiny Witch today. I am greatly inspired by the women in my life, and my wife in particular is a huge inspiration and source of support. Her courage and strength in everyday life motivates me as we work to finish Tiny Witch. I have shared more details about the inspirations for Tiny Witch in this video here:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=08k2-wlJIuE][/url] [b][i](Remember to turn on captions for your language)[/i][/b] 🙂

We are working hard to create a fun and engaging gaming experience. Currently, we are focused on including new accessories, features, and all the little touches that will make the game something special, so that each player can enjoy a unique and captivating experience.

[b][i](Caution! Spoiler below)[/i][/b] 😉


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40614223/ea4116f89f028108fcbb97e9b63abb826d42b12b.gif[/img]


We are grateful for your support and enthusiasm, and we are excited to share even more news with you. In addition to posting frequently here and on our social media channels, our Newsletter is another great way to stay informed about everything we are doing. If you’d like to keep up with the latest on Tiny Witch, be sure to subscribe to it!

[i][b]Subscribe:[/b][/i] [url=https://newsletter.creativehand.com.br/][/url]


Thank you so much for your support of our game. We will bring you more news soon!

Cheers,
Ramon


(P.S. If you haven't already, please add the game to your Wishlist – it makes a big difference for the small indies striving for visibility in the midst of all the amazing games that arrive on Steam every day!)
